data.name: Once Apond a Time
data.detailed_description:
Stuck in a terrible storm, you crash down out of the sky. You find yourself with a broken wing, on a small island in a giant pond. Not knowing what to do, or how to heal your wing, you venture out into the pond...

You'll meet a group of scattered friends, with some animosity lingering between them. As you work on healing your wing, maybe you could help heal their wounds to; creating unbreakable bonds which you will share forever with you're new friends!

------------

Once Apond a Time features 4 unique regions for you to explore, with 4 animal friends for you to meet. Every region has been hand made, down to every last model and texture, all made in house by our amazing artists! And we are proud to say no AI has been used at any point in the art development process!

We made this game as a small team (Team E-Quail) of 8 people, working part time, over the course of half a year. We are happy to get to work with TOTEM to publish our game and share it with you. We hope you will enjoy it as much as we enjoyed making it!

Wishing you fun,
Lauren, Tim, Lars, Lin, Robin, Karem, Lea, & Dinis

data.short_description: You crash down into the middle of a giant pond after a great storm. As you explore the pond you'll meet new friends who share a troubled history. As you work on healing your broken wing, you'll help them heal their past, creating unbreakable new friendships.
